author: rex2630
description: Search one-way and return Ryanair fares, track monthly lows, and receive price alerts in English or Czech.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores watched routes, month, currency, optional price limit, recent fare, alert channel ID, and the server's selected language in Red's Config.
install_msg:
FlightWatch installed. Use /flight search, /flight returnsearch, or /flight watch to get started. Return searches price one traveller. /flight language auto follows the server locale; use cs or en to set it explicitly.

English and Czech documentation: https://github.com/rex2630/TestCogs/tree/main/flightwatch
name: FlightWatch
short: Search Ryanair returns and track monthly fares.
